description: This source file defines a utility namespace 'MicRefreshSupport' providing static functions for managing microphone refresh and voice wake features in an application, including scheduling refresh tasks, observing audio device changes, and binding UI state to application state.

methods.name: startObserver
methods.description: Starts observing an audio input device and triggers a refresh callback when changes occur.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a refresh task to run after a delay, cancelling any previous scheduled task.

methods.name: selectedMicName
methods.description: Returns the name of the selected microphone device given its ID from a list of devices.

methods.name: voiceWakeBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding between the application state and UI control for voice wake feature.
